headline: 轉固定電費省173英鎊
context: 衛報報導，英國家庭改用固定電費方案，一年最多可省下173英鎊，能緩衝10月電價上限調漲的衝擊。

sources.name: The Guardian
sources.summary: Moving tariffs will cushion the blow from the October price cap rise and the increase widely predicted for January With higher energy bills looming and warnings of worse to come in the new year, many households could save up to £173 a year by switching to a fixed deal. Millions of households in Great Britain will face the highest energy charges in three years after it was announced that the government’s price cap will rise again in October. This will be the second increase in three months. Continue reading...

轉固定電費省173英鎊

英國家庭改用固定電費方案，一年最多可省下173英鎊。

這筆錢能緩衝10月電價上限調漲，以及外界預期明年1月還會再漲的衝擊。

—— 本則來自 The Guardian，2026 年 8 月 29 日發佈，讓圖書館員翻譯給你聽。

voice_text: 英國家庭如果改用固定電費方案，一年最多可以省下173英鎊。這筆錢，剛好可以緩衝10月電價上限調漲，還有外界預期明年一月可能再漲一波的衝擊。
